rubric.notes: The same face, eyebrow scar, short hair, muscular build, ivory gi and gray wraps remain readable across all fourteen rows; proxy outliers come from foreshortening and floor poses.
Forward and backward walks alternate support, strikes show anticipation and recovery, and jump, sweep, collapse and victory sequences read in order.
Every pose keeps a clear side-view silhouette, connected anatomy, restrained clothing shapes and a readable center of mass without detached effects.
Grounded states hold the shared foot baseline, jump leaves and returns to it, and knockdown and knockout settle consistently.
Checker, black, gray, white and alpha-mask panels preserve hair, gi edges, toes and interior gaps without visible source-background fringe.
All seventy-nine frames are present in the workbench and every state has deterministic playback evidence with stable scale and timing.
